description:
TBS Education, previously Toulouse Business School and Groupe ESC Toulouse (École supérieure de Commerce de Toulouse), is a triple crown business school established by the Toulouse Chamber of Commerce and Industry in 1903. This pretty selective grande école (an institution of higher learning that accepts applicants after two years of post-baccalaureate preparation) offers a variety of programs, including the most prestigious program, known as the "Grande Ecole" Program (PGE), as well as a joint DBA (bac + 8) with the University of Toulouse, Toulouse School of Management. It is a member of the Federal University of Toulouse Midi-Pyrénées and the Conférence des grandes écoles, and it has earned triple accreditation from EQUIS, AACSB, and AMBA (CGE). It maintains business schools in Toulouse, Paris, Barcelona, and Casablanca and educates more than 7,000 students annually in its first and continuing training programs, many of whom are international, offering business courses in English, French, and Spanish.

TBS Education combines global knowledge, culture, and employability to make sure that you graduate with a degree that is recognized globally, a perspective on global business and management, and a professional network that will serve as a launching pad for your future. Moreover, The TBS staff is committed, seasoned educators and researchers, and prominent international academics make up 52% of the teaching staff.

The five research laboratories that make up TBS Education's scientific enterprise span all significant management disciplines. In these labs, research is carried out in groups. Also, they frequently plan prestigious scientific conferences to unite scholars.

Furthermore, to provide the students the greatest possible start in their professional careers, TBS Education strongly believes in the significance of career assistance and advice, both during and after studies. Therefore, they provide a service, which is specifically customized to the curriculum they are pursuing, is available to all Bachelor, Master, and MSc students both during and after their studies. Three levels of knowledge are used in Career Starter to assist students advance their careers:

This degree, which has an emphasis on international business and business administration, combines classroom instruction with real-world experience through 12 full-time internships spaced out over three years, 6 to 12 months spent studying abroad at a TBS or partner campus, and 50 hours of NGO support. The bachelor degree can be earned through English-only, French-only, or bilingual education; dual degrees are not needed, although they are a possibility.
